title: Privnet connectivity guardrails Terraform module
creator: Priya Shah
description: Build a reusable Terraform module that codifies Redwood's VPC security guardrails for Private deployments. The module will provision opinionated security groups, NACLs, private DNS zones and records, and an enforceable egress policy fabric (egress proxy/NAT patterns + deny-by-default controls). It must include upgrade-safe state migrations, automated health checks (route, DNS resolution, egress allowlist verification), and CI-driven policy scans. Outputs should be minimal and stable for consumers (ids, cidr blocks, DNS zone name). Provide an examples/ folder with three usage patterns: single-AZ dev, multi-AZ production with dedicated egress cluster, and on-prem subnet mapping. The module should be published to the internal Terraform registry and accompanied by a migration guide for existing privnet users.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published to internal registry with semantic versioning
Module provisions security groups and NACLs with default deny inbound and least-privilege egress rules
Private Route53/Cloud DNS zone created and example records for internal services included
Egress policy supports both NAT + egress-proxy integration with toggle variable
Automated health-check Lambda (or equivalent) deployed optionally that verifies: DNS resolution of internal names, outbound connectivity to egress targets, and NACL rule propagation
Module has automated unit tests (terratest) and a CI job that runs plan/validate and a static policy check (tfsec/policy as code)
Migration guide documents state changes and a safe rollout plan for production VPCs
tasks: Draft module public interface (variables/outputs) and example use-cases
Implement SG and NACL resources with explicit dependencies and resource tagging
Add optional private DNS creation + record modules and documented naming conventions
Implement egress-policy toggles and integrate with existing egress-proxy AMI/endpoint
Build health-check job and optional CloudWatch/Datadog monitor playbook
Create terratest cases and CI pipeline templates, include plan diff gating
Author migration doc and rollout playbook with canary steps
Security review and threat model signoff
rollout_plan: Deploy module to staging VPCs in two waves: wave A (non-prod single-AZ) for smoke tests, wave B (prod multi-AZ) with canary subnets. Use feature flag to switch egress-proxy from passthrough to enforced. Monitor DNS resolvability and egress metrics for 48 hours before full rollout.
testing_strategy: Unit tests via terratest covering creation/upgrade paths, tfsec policy checks in CI, smoke validation via test VPCs that run the health-check job, and a scheduled canary run that exercises egress flows daily.
notes: Security requested explicit allowlist by default instead of infra-owned broad rules
We must avoid modifying consumer-managed routes; module exposes hooks but does not replace route tables
Prefer SSM Parameter or Secrets Manager for storing egress-proxy endpoints rather than hardcoding in modules
blockers: Finalize egress-proxy AMI and endpoint contract (infra owners)
Resolve multi-account DNS delegation pattern with platform DNS team
